title: Deleting a Unity Catalog pipeline now retains tables by default
body:
When you delete a Unity Catalog pipeline that uses the default publishing mode, the UI and the Pipelines `DELETE` API retain associated materialized views, streaming tables, and views by default. The retained tables can be queried but cannot be updated until moved into an active pipeline. To delete a pipeline and its tables together, set the `cascade` field to `true` in the API request. This change does not affect Hive metastore pipelines.

See [Delete a pipeline](https://docs.databricks.com/api/workspace/pipelines/delete) and [Delete a pipeline](/aws/en/ldp/unity-catalog#delete-a-pipeline).
